The biggest unresolved question is how much of the reported improvement was durable and whether it reached remote areas evenly, especially for water and sanitation.","evidence":[{"title":"Novo PAC prioritized health and education in low-coverage areas","publisher":"Casa Civil","date":"March 7, 2024","url":"https://www.gov.br/casacivil/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/2024/marco/novo-pac-selecoes-vai-investir-r-23-bilhoes-em-saude-educacao-esporte-e-cultura","summary":"Lula announced R$23 billion for 6,778 works and equipment, including 1,800 UBS units, 685 full-time schools, 1,178 childcare/school units, SAMU ambulances, and community infrastructure. This is direct evidence of expanding access to basic health and education services.","question_ids":["6B.2","5B.6"]},{"title":"Additional health delivery: 500 UBS proposals formally habilitated","publisher":"Ministry of Health","date":"April 25, 2024","url":"https://www.gov.br/saude/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/2024/abril/publicada-habilitacao-de-500-propostas-de-construcao-de-novas-ubs","summary":"The ministry said R$1.1 billion was allocated for 500 new basic health units, with a goal of eventually approving all 1,800 UBS proposals selected under Novo PAC. This supports a concrete increase in primary-care access.","question_ids":["6B.2","5B.6"]},{"title":"Water and sanitation expansion under Novo PAC","publisher":"Casa Civil","date":"July 26, 2024","url":"https://www.gov.br/casacivil/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/2024/julho/novo-pac-selecoes-vai-investir-r-41-7-bi-em-transporte-drenagem-esgotamento-sanitario-abastecimento-de-agua-e-infraestrutura-social-nas-cidades","summary":"The government announced R$41.7 billion for drainage, urban sewage, and urban water supply, with specific lines for “Water for All” and sanitation. This is strong direct evidence of improving access to water and sanitation.","question_ids":["6B.2","5B.6"]},{"title":"Universalization rules for water and sanitation were strengthened","publisher":"ANA","date":"May 10, 2024","url":"https://www.gov.br/ana/pt-br/assuntos/noticias-e-eventos/noticias/ana-publica-norma-de-referencia-sobre-universalizacao-dos-servicos-de-abastecimento-de-agua-e-esgotamento-sanitario","summary":"ANA’s 2024 reference norm set progressive universalization targets for water and sewage, with explicit focus on low-income areas and rural universalization. This is policy infrastructure for broader access, even if it is not itself a finished outcome.","question_ids":["6B.2","5B.6"]},{"title":"Saneamento data system modernized","publisher":"Ministry of Cities","date":"April 4, 2024","url":"https://www.gov.br/cidades/pt-br/acesso-a-informacao/acoes-e-programas/saneamento/sinisa/sinisa-1/sinisa","summary":"SINISA began in 2024 to collect and organize data on water, sewage, urban drainage, and rural sanitation, including regularized access and system evaluation. This strengthens the state’s ability to expand basic services.","question_ids":["6B.2","5B.6","5B.7"]},{"title":"Housing access expanded through Minha Casa, Minha Vida","publisher":"Ministry of Cities","date":"November 5, 2024","url":"https://www.gov.br/cidades/pt-br/assuntos/noticias-1/noticia-mcid-n-796","summary":"The government authorized 4,397 new homes in 77 municipalities, benefiting about 17,000 people, with rural and urban units. This is direct evidence of improved housing access.","question_ids":["6B.2","5B.8"]},{"title":"Housing for low-income families was actually delivered and targeted","publisher":"Ministry of Social Development","date":"May 10, 2024","url":"https://www.gov.br/mds/pt-br/noticias-e-conteudos/desenvolvimento-social/noticias-desenvolvimento-social/minha-casa-minha-vida-entrega-914-unidades-habitacionais-em-maceio","summary":"Lula’s government delivered 914 Minha Casa, Minha Vida units in Maceió; 488 beneficiary families were Bolsa Família or BPC recipients and were exempt from payments. That is a direct social-protection-plus-housing intervention.","question_ids":["6B.2","5B.8"]},{"title":"Food insecurity fell sharply and Bolsa Família remained central","publisher":"Ministry of Social Development / Agência Gov","date":"December 23, 2024","url":"https://www.gov.br/mds/pt-br/noticias-e-conteudos/desenvolvimento-social/noticias-desenvolvimento-social/2024-o-ano-do-combate-a-fome-e-reducao-da-pobreza","summary":"The ministry said 24.4 million people left severe food insecurity in 2024 and poverty fell to its lowest level since 2012; Bolsa Família transferred R$168.3 billion to over 20.86 million families. This is the strongest welfare-access evidence in the file.","question_ids":["6B.2","6B.1","5B.8"]},{"title":"Bolsa Família was explicitly linked to access to health, education, and assistance","publisher":"Ministry of Social Development","date":"December 26, 2023, used in 2024 rollout","url":"https://www.gov.br/mds/pt-br/noticias-e-conteudos/desenvolvimento-social/noticias-desenvolvimento-social/mds-divulga-calendario-de-2024-para-acompanhamento-de-condicionalidades-do-bolsa-familia","summary":"The 2024 conditionality calendar framed Bolsa Família as an access channel to health, education, and social assistance, not just income transfer. That matters because it shows the program’s design as social-service linkage, not pure patronage.","question_ids":["6B.2","6B.1"]},{"title":"Anti-hunger policy was institutionally framed as a core objective","publisher":"Ministry of Social Development","date":"March 12, 2024","url":"https://www.gov.br/mds/pt-br/noticias-e-conteudos/desenvolvimento-social/noticias-desenvolvimento-social/inseguranca-alimentar-no-brasil-cai-30-e-13-milhoes-de-pessoas-deixaram-de-passar-fome-no-brasil/","summary":"A study commissioned by MDS said 13 million people left hunger and 20 million left moderate food insecurity after the first year of Lula’s government, attributing part of the effect to higher minimum wages and Bolsa Família. This supports a real-access improvement, though the source is government-commissioned.","question_ids":["6B.2","6B.1"]},{"title":"Basic sanitation and water access were also backed by legal transparency reforms","publisher":"Planalto","date":"November 4, 2024","url":"https://www.planalto.gov.br/ccivil_03/_ato2023-2026/2024/lei/l15012.htm","summary":"Lula signed a law requiring publication of sanitation documents and periodic reservoir-security reports, expanding public visibility into water security and service quality. That is indirect but real support for access governance.","question_ids":["6B.2","5B.7"]},{"title":"Water/housing shock response after Rio Grande do Sul floods","publisher":"Presidência da República / Reconstrução RS","date":"August 16, 2024","url":"https://www.gov.br/reconstrucaors/pt-br/acompanhe-a-reconstrucao/noticias/presidente-lula-entrega-novas-moradias-a-populacao-do-rio-grande-do-sul","summary":"Lula delivered 173 homes immediately and said 1,290 units would be completed by year-end in the flood-hit state. That is good evidence of crisis-response housing access.","question_ids":["6B.2","5B.9"]},{"title":"Water access remained severely constrained in the Amazon drought","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"September 8, 2024","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/amazon-rivers-low-water-levels-bring-fresh-challenges-for-locals-3606308","summary":"Reuters reported river dwellers carrying water in drought-hit Amazon communities, with locals describing not having drinking water and having to buy it. This is direct counterevidence that basic water access remained precarious in 2024.","question_ids":["6B.2","5B.9"]},{"title":"Reuters documented drought-linked water shortages for elderly and sick residents","publisher":"Reuters Connect","date":"September 8, 2024","url":"https://www.reutersconnect.com/item/drought-in-brazilian-amazon-causes-water-shortage-for-elderly-and-sick/dGFnOnJldXRlcnMuY29tLDIwMjQ6bmV3c21sX1ZBMjU1NzA4MDkyMDI0UlAx","summary":"The Reuters video description shows residents receiving free potable water during historic drought conditions, underscoring that Lula’s service expansion did not eliminate basic-water crises in remote areas.","question_ids":["6B.2","5B.9"]},{"title":"Fiscal tightening created risk to health and education spending","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"November 5, 2024","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/forex-news/brazil-looks-at-curbing-health-education-spending-in-fiscal-package-sources-say-3703870","summary":"Reuters reported the government was considering curbing health and education spending under the fiscal package. That is important caveat evidence: service expansion existed, but budget pressure still threatened it.","question_ids":["6B.2","5B.9"]},{"title":"Yanomami crisis was still severe early in 2024","publisher":"Reuters via UOL","date":"January 26, 2024","url":"https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/01/26/crise-do-povo-yanomami-persiste-apos-308-mortes-em-2023-diz-relatorio.htm","summary":"Yanomami leaders said invasion, malnutrition, disease, and violence were still severe despite the emergency response. This is strong counterevidence that access and protection were not fully restored for one of Brazil’s most vulnerable populations.","question_ids":["6B.2","6B.1","5B.9"]}]}
